purpose: Bounded counterexamples informing proposed framework boundaries

cases.question: row constraints versus concurrent operation
cases.limit: SQLite lock observation plus two sequential guarded operations; no PostgreSQL or exhaustive concurrency proof.

cases.question: contract, storage mechanism and evidence across lost response
cases.limit: One process, exception injection and connection reopen; no machine crash, network or distributed exactly-once test.

cases.question: physical design versus correctness and performance evidence
cases.limit: SQLite plan and answer preservation only; elapsed-time, production workload and PostgreSQL plans not measured.

cases.question: migration shape versus preserved meaning
cases.limit: Synthetic integer conversion, not a database migration rehearsal.

cases.question: verification versus validation
cases.limit: Explicitly constructed mismatch of specification and need; no human-user validation observation.

cases.question: V&V usable without a database dependency
cases.limit: One deterministic library counterexample, not a claim of complete test coverage.
